summary: Post-dependency-revert regression test. requirements.txt was reverted to curated list + twilio>=9.0.0. All backend + frontend flows verified end-to-end. 11/11 pytest tests pass. Quote submission, bedrooms/bathrooms persistence, admin auth (401 on wrong/missing password, 200 on correct), and Twilio SMS all working. Twilio SMS successfully sends (HTTP 201 to Twilio) AND does not block/fail /api/quotes response.
critical_code_review_comments: twilio>=9.0.0 in requirements.txt resolves to v9.10.9 (verified in Twilio HTTP logs). Consider pinning to a specific major.minor to avoid future breaking changes in prod builds.

_send_lead_sms is a synchronous blocking call inside async endpoint - Twilio API call adds ~200-300ms latency to every POST /api/quotes. For scale, consider moving to a background task via BackgroundTasks or a queue.
Twilio credentials are stored plaintext in backend/.env - fine for dev, but for production use a secrets manager and rotate the auth token that has been committed here.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_-prefixed leads during testing (TEST_Jane Doe, TEST_John Full, TEST_BedsBaths Persist, TEST_UI_FullFlow). Admin dashboard shows all 4. No delete endpoint exists to clean them up programmatically; safe to leave for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://expo-book-cleaning.preview.emergentagent.com. Tests: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 11 tests, all green). Twilio SMS is live and confirmed working — sends to +17807185092 from +18255334317 on every new lead. Twilio calls add ~200-300ms latency but do not block/fail the /api/quotes response. Bedrooms/bathrooms fields fully persisted round-trip.
rca of the issue: N/A - dependency revert verified with no regressions.
